operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers everywhere (circuitId, constructorStandings, driverStandingsId); must double-quote with original spelling.
Two tables (pitStops, lapTimes) have 0 rows: original_values empty, original_sizes 0; samplers get no original elements -> p:=1 fresh draws.
Composite PKs: pitStops(raceId,driverId,stop), lapTimes(raceId,driverId,lap) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30; sample_fresh_primary_keys must dedupe on the tuple.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE anywhere; all notnull=0, checked=false -> p never forced to 0 by 'checked'.
FKs all resolve to existing parents (circuits, races, drivers, constructors); no dangling, no self-refs, no non-unique parents.

Declared TEXT columns store dates/times/numbers: races.date 'YYYY-MM-DD', drivers.dob 'DD/MM/YYYY', races.time 'HH:MM:SS', results.time 'M:SS.s', q1/q2/q3 'M:SS.mmm', milliseconds/fastestLapSpeed numeric-as-text.
results.number declared INTEGER but storage classes are ['integer','text'] (mixed) -> Number fuzzer will emit ints, original has some text.
circuits.alt TEXT with only 2 distinct values incl. empty string '' -> String sampler length range [0, max+1] and int-like +-1 perturbations.
drivers.number TEXT with '' among values (distinct 38) -> String sampler will produce '' and int-like neighbors.
constructorResults.status TEXT with literal string 'NULL' (not SQL NULL) and 'D' -> String sampler treats 'NULL' as a normal element.
races.year INTEGER (not 'year' type) dispatches to Number, not the year fuzzer; seasons.year is PK INTEGER likewise Number.
Large tables: results 23777, driverStandings 31726, constructorStandings 11896, constructorResults 11142, qualifying 7516 — under 300k cap, full read fine.
operator_ts_expectations: All PK columns (INTEGER) -> Number fuzzer, scale=0, range [-1,1] with +-1/+-2 perturbation; fresh PKs mostly collide -> sample_fresh_primary_keys drops many rows, shrinking tables.
FK columns (raceId, driverId, constructorId, circuitId) draw with replacement from parent's FINAL filtered values -> heavy duplication, many-to-one joins; ties abundant.
races.date, drivers.dob, races.time declared TEXT -> String fuzzer, NOT Date/Time: random charset strings, not date-shaped; date-format queries (strftime, LIKE '2009-%') will mostly miss -> FN.
results.time/q1/q2/q3/fastestLapTime TEXT -> String fuzzer; lap-time comparisons and ORDER BY on these become random strings -> implausible values, FN.
results.milliseconds/fastestLapSpeed/laps/rank/fastestLap TEXT -> String fuzzer; numeric comparisons on them compare text lexically -> FP/FN.
position/positionText TEXT in results/constructorStandings/driverStandings -> String fuzzer; 'position = 1' vs 'positionText' joins/equalities become random strings.
points REAL -> Number scale=4, range [-10000,10000] with +-0.01/0.02 perturbation; original points are small non-negative -> implausible negatives, FN on 'points > 0' style.
lat/lng REAL -> Number scale=4, range [-10000,10000]; original lat/lng in [-90,180] -> implausible coords, FN on geographic filters.
year/round/wins/grid/positionOrder INTEGER -> Number scale=0 range [-1,1] +-1/2; original years 1950-2017, rounds 1-21 -> almost all values in {-3..3}, FN on 'year > 2000'.
status.status, circuits.country, drivers.nationality, constructors.nationality -> String fuzzer random charset; equality to 'Finished'/'British' etc. rarely matches -> FN on categorical filters.

Empty pitStops/lapTimes: samplers have no elements -> p=1, all fresh; FK columns still draw from parent (races/drivers) so joins non-empty; but original empty -> any query returning rows is FP vs original.
String fuzzer contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop) on url/name/ref columns -> near-duplicate strings, ties on LIKE patterns; may create spurious matches (FP) or break exact matches (FN).
